raw:
- name: gn_decay_factor_ppb
    mutability: runtime-upgrade-only
    on_chain: {storage: [BlockRewards.GnDecayFactor]}
    value: 1_000_000_000
    unit: ppb
    rust: DEFAULT_GN_DECAY_FACTOR_PPB
    quint: DEFAULT_DECAY_PPB
    description: >
      GnDecayFactor read when the key is absent: 1.0, i.e. NO decay, so a period's miner leg is
      split purely by verified G_n (owner decision 2026-10-01, #2144). A factor below 1.0 set on
      the key would weigh a proof gn x factor^min(blocks since period start, 100), floored once.
      The 0.99 the pallet documented was never ratified, and the R7-P0-07 A/B test found every
      decay value cost honest miners more than batchers. Before #2144 the key read 0.
    implementations:
      - { file: pallets/pallets/block-rewards/src/lib.rs,          expect: "DEFAULT_GN_DECAY_FACTOR_PPB: u32 = 1_000_000_000" }
      - { file: formal-specs/rewards/block-rewards-period.qnt,     expect: "DEFAULT_DECAY_PPB: int = 1000000000" }
      - { file: sdk/python/src/flop_sdk/staking_client.py,         expect: "is not None else 1_000_000_000" }
      - { file: sdk/typescript/src/staking-client.ts,              expect: "?? 1_000_000_000" }

  - name: calibration_min_verified_jobs
    mutability: runtime-upgrade-only
    on_chain: {constants: [HwCalibration.MinVerifiedJobs]}
    value: 64
    unit: jobs
    description: "D-0433 minimum independently verified jobs in the quick serving-entry burst. The separate utilization equation still binds the claimed cap to total verified work. yellowpaper §7.1."
    implementations:
      - { file: pallets/runtime/zkverify/src/lib.rs, expect: "CalibrationMinVerifiedJobs: u32 = 64" }
      - { file: infra/vultr/docker-compose.prod.yml, expect: "${CALIBRATION_INITIAL_JOBS:-64}" }

  - name: calibration_min_burst_blocks
    mutability: runtime-upgrade-only
    on_chain: {constants: [HwCalibration.MinBurstBlocks]}
    value: 600
    unit: blocks
    description: "D-0433 minimum chain-timed serving-entry burst (10 minutes at 1s blocks). yellowpaper §7.1."
    implementations:
      - { file: pallets/runtime/zkverify/src/lib.rs, expect: "CalibrationMinBurstBlocks: u32 = 600" }

  - name: calibration_min_utilization_ppm
    mutability: runtime-upgrade-only
    on_chain: {constants: [HwCalibration.MinUtilizationPpm]}
    value: 500_000
    unit: ppm
    description: "Sustained utilization threshold for burst acceptance. Verified expected GN must cover cap × elapsed × this ppm. yellowpaper §7.1."
    implementations:
      - { file: pallets/runtime/zkverify/src/lib.rs, expect: "CalibrationMinUtilizationPpm: u32 = 500_000" }
      - { file: tee-bridge/poui-oracle/src/main.rs, expect: '#[arg(long = "calibration-min-utilization-ppm", default_value = "500000")]' }

  - name: calibration_provisional_discount_ppm
    mutability: runtime-upgrade-only
    on_chain: {constants: [HwCalibration.ProvisionalDiscountPpm]}
    value: 900_000
    unit: ppm
    description: "HARD-tier provisional discount applied to attested SKU ceilings before min(empirical_burst_cap, discounted_sku_ceiling). yellowpaper §7.1."
    implementations:
      - { file: pallets/runtime/zkverify/src/lib.rs, expect: "CalibrationProvisionalDiscountPpm: u32 = 900_000" }

  - name: calibration_lease_blocks
    mutability: runtime-upgrade-only
    on_chain: {constants: [HwCalibration.CalibrationLeaseBlocks]}
    value: 604_800
    unit: blocks
    description: "D-0433 renewable calibration-cap lease (7 days at 1s blocks). At expiry every cap consumer fails closed until fresh verified canaries renew it. yellowpaper §7.2."
    implementations:
      - { file: pallets/runtime/zkverify/src/lib.rs, expect: "CalibrationLeaseBlocks: u32 = 604_800" }
      - { file: tee-bridge/poui-oracle/src/main.rs, expect: '#[arg(long = "calibration-lease-blocks", default_value = "604800")]' }

  - name: calibration_renewal_min_verified_jobs
    mutability: runtime-upgrade-only
    on_chain: {constants: [HwCalibration.RenewalMinVerifiedJobs]}
    value: 8
    unit: jobs
    description: "D-0433 minimum fresh one-shot Ghost canaries for quick restart/offline/periodic cap renewal. Renewal cannot increase the accepted cap. yellowpaper §7.2."
    implementations:
      - { file: pallets/runtime/zkverify/src/lib.rs, expect: "CalibrationRenewalMinVerifiedJobs: u32 = 8" }

  - name: calibration_renewal_max_age_blocks
    mutability: runtime-upgrade-only
    on_chain: {constants: [HwCalibration.RenewalMaxAgeBlocks]}
    value: 600
    unit: blocks
    description: "Maximum miner-triggered renewal window (10 minutes at 1s blocks). Only canaries issued at or after its start qualify, preventing stockpiled credentials from proving a reboot or offline recovery. yellowpaper §7.2."
    implementations:
      - { file: pallets/runtime/zkverify/src/lib.rs, expect: "CalibrationRenewalMaxAgeBlocks: u32 = 600" }
      - { file: tee-bridge/poui-oracle/src/main.rs, expect: '#[arg(long = "calibration-renewal-max-age-blocks", default_value = "600")]' }

  - name: calibration_min_recalibration_interval_blocks
    mutability: runtime-upgrade-only
    on_chain: {constants: [HwCalibration.MinRecalibrationIntervalBlocks]}
    value: 600
    unit: blocks
    description: "Minimum interval between accepted initial calibrations (10 minutes at 1s blocks), preventing rapid cap replacement and strategic retry loops. Lease renewals cannot increase the cap and are not subject to this cooldown. yellowpaper §7.1."
    implementations:
      - { file: pallets/runtime/zkverify/src/lib.rs, expect: "CalibrationMinRecalibrationIntervalBlocks: u32 = 600" }
      - { file: tee-bridge/poui-oracle/src/main.rs, expect: '#[arg(long = "calibration-min-recalibration-interval-blocks", default_value = "600")]' }

  - name: calibration_max_gpu_inventory_entries
    mutability: runtime-upgrade-only
    on_chain: {constants: [HwCalibration.MaxGpuInventoryEntries]}
    value: 16
    unit: distinct SKUs
    description: "Maximum distinct attested GPU SKUs on one miner host. Device multiplicity is represented by a u16 count per SKU. yellowpaper §7.1."
    implementations:
      - { file: pallets/runtime/zkverify/src/lib.rs, expect: "CalibrationMaxGpuInventoryEntries: u32 = 16" }
